claim: AI to increase payment acceptance and reduce fraud for businesses
AI to increase payment acceptance and reduce fraud for businesses. Founded in 2022 by Saif Farooqui, Corgi Labs has 3 employees based in Singapore.

Saif Farooqui, Founder: Saif is the founder of Corgi Labs, where he builds modern fraud and payments intelligence for fast-growing businesses. Previously, Saif was a Data Scientist at Stripe, Google and Facebook (now Meta), and a healthcare economist in an earlier life.
Website description: Corgi Labs uses AI to recover lost payment revenue and optimize authorization rates for ecommerce and SaaS businesses. Reduce chargebacks, prevent fraud, and increase approvals.
